methods.chapter1: 2007 hierarchy by continent; country nodes alphabetical and equal-sized; outer bar lengths linearly proportional to population; right bars show the ten largest populations in this excerpt. Position is not geographical.
methods.chapter2: 2007 population cross-tabulation: continent -> GDP bins [0,2000,8000,20000,inf) -> life bins [0,50,65,75,inf). Both edge layers conserve the excerpt population; not migration.
methods.chapter3: All 1704 lifeExp values; common domain [23,83], one panel per continent, countries sorted by 2007 lifeExp. Labels are sampled, cells are not.
methods.chapter4: 2007 x=log10(gdpPercap), y=lifeExp; bubble area exactly proportional to pop; KDE in log-GDP/life coordinates, Gaussian bandwidths 0.22 log10 units and 4 years, no population weights; 72x52 grid, contours at .2,.4,.6,.8 of maximum; marginal histograms count countries.
methods.chapter5: All country trajectories, linear joins at 12 five-year observations; no interpolation of missing years; right panel ranks 2007 minus 1952 life expectancy.
